shared_elements: incised or carved relief on a rock surface
justification: A depicts a highly specific anthropomorphic figure — a head with heavy brow and elongated ears above a torso bearing incised circular motifs, arcs and a belt-like band across the back — while B shows a rock face with vertical cut recesses or niche-like hollows and no identifiable figural or symbolic imagery. The only correspondence is the generic presence of vertical rectangular divisions on a large stone surface, which is not an iconographic link.
